description: This file defines the 'MacNodeRuntime' actor class, which manages various system functionalities such as camera, location, system commands, page interactions, and more within a macOS environment. It handles invoking commands, managing permissions, interacting with services like Canvas, CameraCapture, and executing system processes with security considerations.

classes.name: MacNodeRuntime
classes.description: Actor class managing system commands, permissions, canvas, camera, location, and various system interactions for macOS.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main entry point for handling different command requests, routing to specific handlers.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the main session key used for interactions.

methods.name: setEventSender
methods.description: Sets the event sender callback for emitting events.

methods.name: handleCanvasInvoke
methods.description: Handles commands related to the Canvas (e.g., present, hide, navigate, evalJS, snapshot).

methods.name: handleA2UIInvoke
methods.description: Handles A2UI messages such as reset and push.

methods.name: handleBrowserProxyInvoke
methods.description: Handles browser proxy requests, verifying if enabled.

methods.name: handleCameraInvoke
methods.description: Handles camera-related commands: snap, clip, list.

methods.name: handleLocationInvoke
methods.description: Handles location fetching requests with permission checks.

methods.name: handleScreenRecordInvoke
methods.description: Handles screen recording requests.

methods.name: mainActorServices
methods.description: Returns cached or new instance of main actor services.

methods.name: handleA2UIReset
methods.description: Resets the A2UI interface via JavaScript execution.

methods.name: handleA2UIPush

methods.name: ensureA2UIHost
methods.description: Ensures that A2UI host is available and reachable.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the URL for the A2UI host gateway.

methods.name: isA2UIReady
methods.description: Checks if A2UI is ready, optionally polling.

methods.name: handleSystemRun
methods.description: Handles execution of system commands with security and approval checks.

methods.name: handleSystemWhich
methods.description: Finds the paths of binaries (commands) in preferred search paths.

methods.name: resolveSystemRunApproval

methods.description: Records allowlist pattern matches for auditing.

methods.name: validateScreenRecordingIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and enforces screen recording permission if required.

methods.name: executeSystemRun
